newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lincoln National cut. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lincoln National cut. [CORRECTED 15:30 GMT]

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said on Wednesday analyst Edward Spehar had downgraded his rating for Lincoln National Corp to neutral from outperform.
-- In a report, Spehar wrote, "In our view the stock price now fully reflects the 'normalized earnings power' of the company."
-- Shares in the Fort Wayne, Ind. insurance company were off 1/4 to 59-1/2 in early trade. (Corrects headquarters' location from New York to Fort Wayne).
